about: Every screen name scripts/store-screenshots.sh contacts captures for Tenshu Contacts (`captured`, from the UI test in `uiTests`). The fixture is an invented address book (store/fixtures/contacts/manifest.json → generate_contacts.py), imported through the shared repository's importVcards on a seed launch; every capture comes from the next launch, by taps (docs/how-to/store-screenshots.md §3c). Adding a capture means adding it here. Docs: docs/how-to/store-screenshots.md §5.

01-contacts.shows: The contact list, with the possible-duplicates row above it

02-contact.shows: A contact: phone numbers, email addresses, address, organisation, note and keys

03-search.shows: Search by organisation: three colleagues found

04-duplicates.shows: Possible duplicates, each with the reason it was suggested

05-merge.shows: Merging a pair: which one should be kept

06-you.shows: You: the name people see when you invite them

android.about: The Android pipeline (scripts/store-screenshots-android.sh, walk in scripts/lib/android_shots.py) captures these on a 1080x2400 phone AVD, light only, keyed android/phone/<lang>/NN-screen. Same names as iOS for the same screen; a name new to Android must also be listed in captured or planned above, so a number never means two screens.
